verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י רָעָב֩ בִּימֵ֨י דָוִ֜ד שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים שָׁנָה֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וַיְבַקֵּ֥שׁ דָּוִ֖ד אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑הס וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַדָּמִ֔ים עַל־ אֲשֶׁר־ הֵמִ֖ית אֶת־ הַגִּבְעֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî rā·‘āḇ bî·mê ḏā·wiḏ šā·lōš šā·nîm šā·nāh ’a·ḥă·rê šā·nāh way·ḇaq·qêš dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- pə·nê yə·h·wå̄·hs way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- šā·’ūl wə·’el- bêṯ had·dā·mîm ‘al- ’ă·šer- hê·mîṯ ’eṯ- hag·giḇ·‘ō·nîm
verses.literal: During the reign of David there was a famine for three successive years . . . . . . . . . and David sought the face of the LORD And the LORD said It is because of the blood shed by Saul and his family because he killed the Gibeonites
verses.literalPt: Houve, nos dias de Davi, uma fome de três anos consecutivos; e Davi consultou a Jeová. Jeová disse: Há sangue sobre Saul e sobre a sua casa, porque matou os gibeonitas.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ לַגִּבְעֹנִ֖ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְהַגִּבְעֹנִ֞ים לֹ֣א מִבְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֚י אִם־ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָאֱמֹרִ֔י וּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נִשְׁבְּע֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם וַיְבַקֵּ֤שׁ שָׁאוּל֙ לְהַכֹּתָ֔ם בְּקַנֹּאת֥וֹ לִבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ham·me·leḵ lag·giḇ·‘ō·nîm way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem wə·hag·giḇ·‘ō·nîm lō mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh kî ’im- mî·ye·ṯer hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl niš·bə·‘ū lā·hem way·ḇaq·qêš šā·’ūl lə·hak·kō·ṯām bə·qan·nō·ṯōw liḇ·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: At this, David summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them Now the Gibeonites were not Israelites . . . but a remnant of the Amorites The Israelites . . . had taken an oath concerning them . . . but in his zeal for Israel . . . and Judah Saul had sought to kill them
verses.literalPt: Chamou o rei aos gibeonitas e disse-lhes (Ora, os gibeonitas não eram dos filhos de Israel, mas do resto dos amorreus; e os filhos de Israel se tinham ligado a eles por juramento; Saul, porém, procurou feri-los no seu zelo pelos filhos de Israel e de Judá.),

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל־ הַגִּבְעֹנִ֔ים מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לָכֶ֑ם וּבַמָּ֣ה אֲכַפֵּ֔ר וּבָרְכ֖וּ אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- hag·giḇ·‘ō·nîm māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·ḵem ū·ḇam·māh ’ă·ḵap·pêr ū·ḇā·rə·ḵū ’eṯ- na·ḥă·laṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So David . . . asked the Gibeonites What shall I do for you How can I make amends so that you may bless the inheritance of the LORD
verses.literalPt: sim, Davi perguntou-lhes: Que quereis que eu vos faça? Com que farei expiação, para que abençoeis a herança de Jeová?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣וֹ הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗ים אֵֽין־ לִי כֶּ֤סֶף וְזָהָב֙ עִם־ שָׁא֣וּל וְעִם־ בֵּית֔וֹ וְאֵֽין־ לָ֥נוּ אִ֖ישׁ לְהָמִ֣ית בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מָֽה־ אַתֶּ֥ם אֹמְרִ֖ים אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lōw hag·giḇ·‘ō·nîm ’ên- lī ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ ‘im- šā·’ūl wə·‘im- bê·ṯōw wə·’ên- lā·nū ’îš lə·hā·mîṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer māh- ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The Gibeonites said to him We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us Whatever you ask I will do for you he replied
verses.literalPt: Responderam-lhe os gibeonitas: Não é por prata nem por ouro que temos questão com Saul ou com a sua casa; nem pretendemos tirar a vida a homem algum em Israel. Davi disse: O que vós disserdes, isso vos farei.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔נוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּמָּה־ לָ֑נוּ נִשְׁמַ֕דְנוּ מֵֽהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב בְּכָל־ גְּבֻ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- ham·me·leḵ hā·’îš ’ă·šer kil·lā·nū wa·’ă·šer dim·māh- lā·nū niš·maḏ·nū mê·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ bə·ḵāl gə·ḇul yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And they answered the king As for the man who consumed us and plotted against us to exterminate us from existing within any border of Israel
verses.literalPt: Responderam ao rei: Quanto ao homem que nos consumiu e pensou em nos destruir, para que não ficássemos em qualquer termo de Israel,

verses.original: יְנָתָן לָ֜נוּ שִׁבְעָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ מִבָּנָ֔יו וְהוֹקַֽעֲנוּם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּגִבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל בְּחִ֣יר יְהוָ֑הס וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲנִ֥י אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: yə·nå̄·ṯå̄n lā·nū šiḇ·‘āh ’ă·nā·šîm mib·bā·nāw wə·hō·w·qa·‘ă·nūm Yah·weh bə·ḡiḇ·‘aṯ šā·’ūl bə·ḥîr yə·h·wå̄·hs way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’ă·nî ’et·tên
verses.literal: let seven . . . of his male descendants be delivered to us so that we may hang them before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul the chosen of the LORD I will give them to you said the king
verses.literalPt: deem-se-nos sete de seus filhos, para que os enforquemos a Jeová, em Gibeá de Saul, o eleito de Jeová. Disse o rei: Eu os darei.

verses.original: וַיַּחְמֹ֣ל הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל־ מְפִי־ בֹ֖שֶׁת בֶּן־ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בֶּן־ שָׁא֑וּל עַל־ שְׁבֻעַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּֽינֹתָ֔ם בֵּ֣ין דָּוִ֔ד וּבֵ֖ין יְהוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־ שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·mōl ham·me·leḵ ‘al- mə·p̄î- ḇō·šeṯ ben- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·’ūl ‘al- šə·ḇu·‘aṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer bê·nō·ṯām bên dā·wiḏ ū·ḇên yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Now the king spared . . . Mephibosheth . . . son of Jonathan the son of Saul because of the oath before the LORD between . . . David and Jonathan son of Saul
verses.literalPt: O rei, porém, poupou a Mefibosete, filho de Jônatas, filho de Saul, por causa do juramento de Jeová que havia entre eles, a saber, entre Davi e Jônatas, filho de Saul.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־ שְׁ֠נֵי בְּנֵ֨י רִצְפָּ֤ה בַת־ אַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלְדָ֣ה לְשָׁא֔וּל אֶת־ אַרְמֹנִ֖י וְאֶת־ מְפִבֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֶת־ חֲמֵ֗שֶׁת בְּנֵי֙ מִיכַ֣ל בַּת־ שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֛ה לְעַדְרִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ בַּרְזִלַּ֖י הַמְּחֹלָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ham·me·leḵ ’e·ṯōš- šə·nê bə·nê riṣ·pāh ḇaṯ- ’ay·yāh ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh lə·šā·’ūl ’eṯ- ’ar·mō·nî wə·’eṯ- mə·p̄i·ḇō·šeṯ wə·’eṯ- ḥă·mê·šeṯ bə·nê mî·ḵal baṯ- šā·’ūl ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh lə·‘aḏ·rî·’êl ben- bar·zil·lay ham·mə·ḥō·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth the two sons whom Rizpah daughter of Aiah had borne to Saul as well as the five sons whom Merab daughter of Saul had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite
verses.literalPt: Mas o rei tomou os dois filhos de Rispa, filha de Aiá, Armoni e Mefibosete, os quais houvera de Saul, também os cinco filhos de Merabe, filha de Saul, que ela deu à luz a Adriel, filho de Barzilai, meolatita,

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֞ם בְּיַ֣ד הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗ים וַיֹּקִיעֻ֤ם בָּהָר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּפְּל֥וּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם יָ֑חַד וְהֵם הֻמְת֜וּ בִּימֵ֤י קָצִיר֙ בָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים תְּחִלַּת קְצִ֥יר שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ hag·giḇ·‘ō·nîm way·yō·qî·‘um bā·hār lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yip·pə·lū šiḇ·ʿå̄·ṯa·yim yā·ḥaḏ wə·hēm hum·ṯū bî·mê qā·ṣîr bā·ri·šō·nîm tə·ḥil·laṯ qə·ṣîr śə·‘ō·rîm
verses.literal: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites and they hanged them on the hill before the LORD So all seven of them fell together they were put to death in the first days of the harvest at the beginning of the barley harvest
verses.literalPt: e entregou-os nas mãos dos gibeonitas, que os enforcaram no monte, diante de Jeová, e todos os sete caíram juntos. Foram mortos nos dias da ceifa, nos primeiros dias, no princípio da ceifa da cevada.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח רִצְפָּה֩ בַת־ אַיָּ֨ה אֶת־ הַשַּׂ֜ק וַתַּטֵּ֨הוּ לָ֤הּ אֶל־ הַצּוּר֙ מִתְּחִלַּ֣ת קָצִ֔יר עַ֛ד נִתַּךְ־ מַ֥יִם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִן־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנָה֩ ע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם לָנ֤וּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֶת־ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ riṣ·pāh ḇaṯ- ’ay·yāh ’eṯ- haś·śaq wat·taṭ·ṭê·hū lāh ’el- haṣ·ṣūr mit·tə·ḥil·laṯ qā·ṣîr ‘aḏ nit·taḵ- ma·yim ‘ă·lê·hem min- haš·šā·mā·yim wə·lō- nā·ṯə·nāh ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim lā·nū·aḥ ‘ă·lê·hem yō·w·mām wə·’eṯ- ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock From the beginning of the harvest until the rain from heaven poured down on the bodies she did not allow . . . the birds of the air to rest on them by day nor the beasts of the field by night
verses.literalPt: Rispa, filha de Aiá, tomou um pano de cilício e estendeu-o para si sobre uma pedra, desde o princípio da ceifa até que a água caiu do céu sobre eles; não deixou aproximar-se deles as aves de dia, nem as feras de noite.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֖ד לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשְׂתָ֛ה רִצְפָּ֥ה בַת־ אַיָּ֖ה פִּלֶ֥גֶשׁ שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh riṣ·pāh ḇaṯ- ’ay·yāh pi·le·ḡeš šā·’ūl
verses.literal: When David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah had done
verses.literalPt: Foi contado a Davi o que fizera Rispa, filha de Aiá e concubina de Saul.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ עַצְמ֤וֹת שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶת־ עַצְמוֹת֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֔וֹ מֵאֵ֕ת בַּעֲלֵ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֲשֶׁר֩ גָּנְב֨וּ אֹתָ֜ם מֵרְחֹ֣ב בֵּֽית־ שַׁ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תָּלוּם שָׁם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּי֨וֹם הַכּ֧וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛ים אֶת־ שָׁא֖וּל בַּגִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ šā·’ūl wə·’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nōw mê·’êṯ ba·‘ă·lê yā·ḇêš gil·‘āḏ ’ă·šer gā·nə·ḇū ’ō·ṯām mê·rə·ḥōḇ bêṯ- šan ’ă·šer tå̄·lūm šå̄m hap·pə·liš·tīm bə·yō·wm hak·kō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- šā·’ūl bag·gil·bō·a‘
verses.literal: he went and took the bones of Saul - and his son Jonathan from the men of Jabesh-gilead . . . who had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan . . . where the Philistines had hung the bodies . . . after they had struck down Saul at Gilboa
verses.literalPt: Foi Davi e tomou os ossos de Saul e os ossos de Jônatas aos homens de Jabes-Gileade, que os tinham roubado da praça de Bete-Seã, na qual os filisteus os tinham pendurado no dia em que mataram a Saul em Gilboa.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל מִשָּׁם֙ אֶת־ עַצְמ֣וֹת שָׁא֔וּל וְאֶת־ עַצְמ֖וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֑וֹ וַיַּ֣אַסְפ֔וּ אֶת־ עַצְמ֖וֹת הַמּוּקָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al miš·šām ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ šā·’ūl wə·’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nōw way·ya·’as·p̄ū ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ham·mū·qā·‘îm
verses.literal: So David had the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan brought from there and they also gathered the bones of those who had been hanged
verses.literalPt: Dali trouxe Davi os ossos de Saul e os de seu filho Jônatas; e recolheram os ossos dos que foram enforcados.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֶת־ עַצְמוֹת־ שָׁא֣וּל וִיהוֹנָֽתָן־ בְּ֠נוֹ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן בְּצֵלָ֗ע בְּקֶ֙בֶר֙ קִ֣ישׁ אָבִ֔יו וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָאָ֖רֶץ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·rū ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ- šā·’ūl wî·hō·w·nā·ṯān- bə·nōw bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min bə·ṣê·lā‘ bə·qe·ḇer qîš ’ā·ḇîw way·ya·‘ă·śū kōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh ham·me·leḵ way·yê·‘ā·ṯêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·’ā·reṣ ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên
verses.literal: And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in Zela in the land of Benjamin in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish After they had done everything the king had commanded God answered their prayers for the land
verses.literalPt: Enterraram os ossos de Saul e de seu filho Jônatas na terra de Benjamim, em Zela, na sepultura de Quis, seu pai. Fizeram tudo o que o rei ordenara. Depois disso, Deus se tornou propício para com a terra.

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ ע֧וֹד מִלְחָמָ֛ה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֨רֶד דָּוִ֜ד וַעֲבָדָ֥יו עִמּ֛וֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמ֥וּ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיָּ֥עַף דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî- ‘ō·wḏ mil·ḥā·māh lap·pə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·reḏ dā·wiḏ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ‘im·mōw way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm way·yā·‘ap̄ dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Once again . . . the Philistines waged war against Israel and David and his servants . . . went down and fought against the Philistines But David became exhausted
verses.literalPt: De novo, fizeram os filisteus guerra contra Israel. Desceu Davi com os seus servos, e pelejaram contra os filisteus. Ficando Davi muito fatigado,

verses.original: וְיִשְׁבּוֹ בְּנֹ֜ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בִּילִידֵ֣י הָרָפָ֗ה וּמִשְׁקַ֤ל קֵינוֹ֙ שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ מִשְׁקַ֣ל נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְה֖וּא חָג֣וּר חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְהַכּ֥וֹת אֶת־ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiš·bō bə·nōḇ ’ă·šer bî·lî·ḏê hā·rā·p̄āh ū·miš·qal qê·nōw šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ miš·qal nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·hū ḥā·ḡūr ḥă·ḏā·šāh way·yō·mer lə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Then Ishbi-benob a descendant of Rapha whose bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and who was bearing a new sword resolved to kill David
verses.literalPt: Isbi-Benobe, que era dos filhos do gigante, cuja lança pesava trezentos siclos de cobre e que cingia uma espada nova, intentou matá-lo.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲזָר־ לוֹ֙ אֲבִישַׁ֣י בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֔ה וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ אָ֣ז נִשְׁבְּעוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁי־ דָוִ֨ד ל֜וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־ תֵצֵ֨א ע֤וֹד אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תְכַבֶּ֖ה אֶת־ נֵ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zār- lōw ’ă·ḇî·šay ben- ṣə·rū·yāh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tî way·mî·ṯê·hū ’āz niš·bə·‘ū ’an·šê- ḏā·wiḏ lōw lê·mōr lō- ṯê·ṣê ‘ō·wḏ ’it·tā·nū lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·lō ṯə·ḵab·beh ’eṯ- nêr yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid . . . struck the Philistine and killed him Then David’s men swore to him . . . You must never again go out with us to battle so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished
verses.literalPt: Abisai, porém, filho de Zeruia, socorreu-o, feriu ao filisteu e matou-o. Então, os homens de Davi lhe juraram, dizendo: Não tornarás a sair conosco à batalha, para que não apagues a lâmpada de Israel.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַתְּהִי־ ע֧וֹד הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה בְּג֖וֹב עִם־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים אָ֣ז הִכָּ֗ה סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י אֶת־ סַ֕ף אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּילִדֵ֥י הָרָפָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên wat·tə·hî- ‘ō·wḏ ham·mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḡō·wḇ ‘im- pə·liš·tîm ’āz hik·kāh sib·bə·ḵay ha·ḥu·šā·ṯî ’eṯ- sap̄ ’ă·šer bî·li·ḏê hā·rā·p̄āh
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . at Gob there was another battle with the Philistines At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph a descendant of Rapha
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, houve ainda, em Gobe, uma guerra contra os filisteus; então, Sibecai, husatita, matou a Safe, que era dos filhos do gigante.

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ ע֧וֹד הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה בְּג֖וֹב עִם־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּ֡ךְ אֶלְחָנָן֩ בֶּן־ יַעְרֵ֨י אֹרְגִ֜ים בֵּ֣ית הַלַּחְמִ֗י אֵ֚ת גָּלְיָ֣ת הַגִּתִּ֔י וְעֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֔וֹ כִּמְנ֖וֹר אֹרְגִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî- ‘ō·wḏ ham·mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḡō·wḇ ‘im- pə·liš·tîm way·yaḵ ’el·ḥā·nān ben- ya‘·rê ’ō·rə·ḡîm bêṯ hal·laḥ·mî ’êṯ gā·lə·yāṯ hag·git·tî wə·‘êṣ ḥă·nî·ṯōw kim·nō·wr ’ō·rə·ḡîm
verses.literal: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines at Gob and Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam
verses.literalPt: Houve ainda, em Gobe, mais uma guerra contra os filisteus; e Elanã, filho de Jaaré-Oregim, belemita, matou a Golias, geteu, de cuja lança a haste era como órgão de tecelão.

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּגַ֑ת וַיְהִ֣י׀ אִ֣ישׁ מָדִין וְאֶצְבְּעֹ֣ת יָדָיו֩ וְאֶצְבְּעֹ֨ת רַגְלָ֜יו שֵׁ֣שׁ וָשֵׁ֗שׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְאַרְבַּע֙ מִסְפָּ֔ר וְגַם־ ה֖וּא יֻלַּ֥ד לְהָרָפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî- ‘ō·wḏ mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḡaṯ way·hî ’îš må̄·ḏīn wə·’eṣ·bə·‘ōṯ yā·ḏāw wə·’eṣ·bə·‘ōṯ raḡ·lāw šêš wā·šêš ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·ba‘ mis·pār wə·ḡam- hū yul·laḏ lə·hā·rā·p̄āh
verses.literal: And there was also a battle at Gath where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot twenty-four . . . in all He too was descended from Rapha
verses.literalPt: De novo, houve guerra em Gate, onde estava um homem de grande estatura, o qual tinha seis dedos em cada mão e, em cada pé, seis dedos; vinte e quatro ao todo. Este também nasceu gigante.

verses.original: וַיְחָרֵ֖ף אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּכֵּ֙הוּ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בֶּן־ שִׁמְעִי אֲחִ֥י דָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥā·rêp̄ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kê·hū yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šim·ʿī ’ă·ḥî ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: and when he taunted Israel Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him
verses.literalPt: Quando ele injuriava a Israel, tirou-lhe a vida Jônatas, filho de Simei, irmão de Davi.

verses.original: אֶת־ אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֵ֛לֶּה יֻלְּד֥וּ לְהָרָפָ֖ה בְּגַ֑ת וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בְיַד־ דָּוִ֖ד וּבְיַ֥ד עֲבָדָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’ar·ba·‘aṯ ’êl·leh yul·lə·ḏū lə·hā·rā·p̄āh bə·ḡaṯ way·yip·pə·lū ḇə·yaḏ- dā·wiḏ ū·ḇə·yaḏ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: So these four descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David . . . and his servants
verses.literalPt: Esses quatro nasceram ao gigante em Gate; e caíram pela mão de Davi e pela mão dos seus servos.
